_comment: Products that stand in for one another. Hand-edited, never generated — the same status as preferences.json. A group means: anything the household already has from this group counts against a recipe calling for any other member. The page always names the product that did the covering, so a match is reported, never silent. "kg" is the pack weight, and is required on every unit-priced member of a group that also contains a kg-priced one, so a tray can be counted against a recipe asking for kilos.
